Q: Typing a restricted wrapper of isinstance A:

This is the kind of "convenience" that is only barely more convenient for the caller but causes all sorts of issues for the function itself. Just require typ: tuple[type[T], ...] (or as I suspect would be sufficient, Sequence[type[T]] or Iterable[type[T]]) and make the caller do x.comma_separated_list_ex((foo,), bar) instead of x.comma_separated_list_ex(foo, bar).

Q: Why do i have both `/Library/Developer/CoreSimulator` and `~/Library/Developer/CoreSimulator` A:

/Library/Developer/CoreSimulator This is system level simulator data which is used by macOS and xCode internal use. Do not remove them as it is for system use if try to delete you may be end up facing simulator launch issues, runtime issues e.t.c.

~/Library/Developer/CoreSimulator This one is user level simulator data where all your iOS simulators contents are stored. Yes it is Safe to remove them as long as you want to reset your simulator.

Q: Laravel Media Conversions not being created with laravel-medialibrary on Amazon S3 A:

In Laravel 10.x onwards the best thing is to do the following:

OPTION 1:

If you don't have any other Queued job then set this in your .env file:

QUEUE_CONNECTION=sync

That should work without anything doing further. If it fails then go for the OPTION 2.

OPTION 2:

If you have another queued job like email that needed to be set as QUEUE_CONNECTION=database then use the following process one by one:

First Let's create the configuration file for managing media, if that is not yet created in your config directory:

php artisan vendor:publish --provider="Spatie\MediaLibrary\MediaLibraryServiceProvider" --tag="config"

The command will create the config file at config/media-library.php.

Step 1: Publish and configure the config file

After publishing the config file, set these values in config/media-library.php:

'queue_conversions_by_default' => env('QUEUE_CONVERSIONS_BY_DEFAULT', true), // true
'temporary_directory_path' => storage_path('media-library/temp'), // Set explicit temp path

Step 2: Configure a dedicated queue connection for media to Sync

In config/queue.php, add a dedicated connection:

'connections' => [
    // ... your existing connections
    
    'medialibrary' => [
        'driver' => 'sync'
    ],
],

Step 3: Tell Media Library to use this dedicated connection

In your config/media-library.php, add or modify:

'queue_connection_name' => env('MEDIA_LIBRARY_QUEUE_CONNECTION', 'medialibrary'),

Then in .env:

MEDIA_LIBRARY_QUEUE_CONNECTION=medialibrary
QUEUE_CONNECTION=database  # Your email system stays on database

All sets up. Your Media conversion should work well now.

IMPORTANT:

If nothing workds above then don't forget to verify Your Server Has Image Processing Capabilities by running:

php -m | grep -E "gd|imagick|exif"

If missing, install them (Ubuntu/Debian):

sudo apt-get install php8.4-gd php8.4-exif  # Adjust PHP version as needed

Hope that helps! Happy coding :)

Q: This command line with Ansible YUM is not working A:

In my condition, I need to install the YUM package and reconfigure the virtual environment with flag --system-site-packages on the target host, and then use Ansible environment variable ansible_python_interpreter.

yum install yum
virtualenv --system-site-packages venv

Q: How to get the attribute assignments from multiple <lang> tags A:

The easiest way would be

#<lang (\w+=[^<]*(<[^>]+>)?[^<]+(?(2)</[^>]+>))>#

The Regex checks if a tag is matched and only then checks for ending tag.

If you want to catch also the fourth argument, you need to use

#<lang (\w+(=[^<]*(<[^>]+>)?[^<]+(?(3)</[^>]+>))?)>#
